resolution: Raised kv_cache_gb from 8 to 16 and capped max_num_seqs at 64; throughput recovered to 17 tok/s within 10 minutes.
summary: Inference throughput fell from 18 to 3 tok/s after max_num_seqs was raised without raising the KV cache budget. KV cache hit 97 percent and the scheduler fell back to batch size 1.
title: Throughput collapse on gpu-node-02 after a config change

resolution: Replaced the optic on leaf-01 uplink to spine-01; added a CRC-error rate alert so the next one pages earlier.
summary: Packet loss 2.1 percent with CRC errors climbing on leaf-01 eth1. Draining the link and replacing the optic cleared the errors; CRC counters stayed at zero for 48 hours.
title: Packet loss on leaf-01 uplink traced to a faulty optic

resolution: Restored max_num_seqs to 64; added a guardrail so a rollback cannot ship a batching config below 32 without review.
summary: gpu-node-03 sat at 12 percent utilisation while 140 requests queued. max_num_seqs was 8 after a rollback. Raising it to 64 lifted utilisation to 71 percent and cleared the queue.
title: GPU at 12 percent util with a growing queue

resolution: No action. Documented as a capacity headroom note: the fleet handles 2.5x peaks without breaching SLOs.
summary: p99 latency doubled for 20 minutes with no errors and no alerts. Traffic was 2.4x the normal peak for a batch job; the system absorbed it and latency returned to normal on its own.
title: Latency spike that turned out to be a traffic surge
